defects.what: Six glowing floating tags around Indio carry pseudo-words ("AIDVE", "BRVE", "RIZEY") and the bottle at left has a gibberish label, right at the center of the frame.
The stone marker plaque at left behind Indio shows three lines of clearly visible gibberish letters instead of a blank or correct marker text.
defects.fixed_note: redrawn; a small dark marker plate remains half hidden in the grass at the cross base, not readable at phone size

defects.what: A human anime face with two eyes peers out of the crack in the center of the moon, reading as a face on the moon rather than the serpent biting it.
A hard white horizontal line cuts straight across the whole frame at chest height over both M and Indio, reading like a panel split; a pink blossom tree and snow-capped peak also sit at top right.
Several bottle labels in the lower half carry pseudo-text and glyph rows (one reads like "RRY" with a barcode).
The yellow shop sign at upper right and small signs at left carry pseudo-letters.
The green shop sign at upper left has pseudo-text and the gold bracelet on his raised wrist shows letter-like glyphs.
The man leaning on the helicopter, presumably Indio, has short loose hair with no topknot, no medallion and a grey jacket, and the helicopter nose carries a pseudo-text badge.
Indio, seen from behind at left, has reddish-brown hair with no topknot and a beige tunic and shorts instead of the off-white collarless shirt.
Indio lying under the palms has messy brown hair with no topknot and no medallion.
Two small US-style striped flags fly on the yacht masts in the upper left background.
The licence plate on the white car at bottom left shows small pseudo-text.
